title: (III) ESCHATOLOGY: On body and soul
english_translation:
[R] {ae.1} ... By this it is evident that it is of the same stuff (gohr) as the body. That is evident from what I wrote above, and it is clear to those of select judgement.

{ae.2} And since these two - both (5) the bodily frame (tenigerd) and the spirituality (mênogih) - are both dark, unknowing, and undiscriminating, and of the same kind substance (mayag) of the body, we must ask, of what (10) kind and of what stuff is the soul?

{ae.3} And since the kind and stuff of the soul has been revealed in many places in this book, it is not difficult to know it, namely that the soul is of different stuff from the body and is mixed and fitted and bound in the body (15) with the spirituality of the body, that is, anger, lust (az), and desire, like

[V] {ae.4} ... in the state of being of one stuff, mixture, fittedness, and binding, thus it is not possible like pure silver, which, because no (5) mixture, fittedness, and binding with *otherness is evident in it when it is one and unmixed, but when the silver is mixed with copper or something else, then the mixture, fittedness, and (10) binding with that thing is as evident in it as a copper drachma or a sytwg.

{ae.5} And in similar manner and like the silver in copper, the soul inside the brute matter (15) and frame of the body, consisting of bone, flesh, skin, blood, wind, [ ... ], and filth [ ... ] with the bond of the spirituality [of the body] from the eye, which ...
